description: Character creation (CDROM/EXEDIR/NAME_ENT.EXN): name/nickname questions and the birthday/blood-type prompts. The '名前:'/'あだ名:' labels, the birthday page's and summary's words and the side buttons are graphics (name_entry_labels.json, name_entry_buttons.json); the kana grid itself (0x19150-) is the set of characters the player types with and is left alone for now. Default names (藤崎/詩織) and the cheat-name list (0x19590-) are data and must not be translated blindly.

strings.original: あなたの名字を教えてくれる？
誕生日と血液型も教えてね？
藤崎詩織の誕生日と血液型は覚えてる？
